configuration.query: how many critical tickets still not resolved yet in each category
configuration.rephrase: The query will find those support tickets where priority is high and ticket status is open, then group them by category and count number of tickets in each category.
configuration.standardsql: SELECT [cr884_category],  COUNT(*) AS [countOfTickets] FROM [supportticket] WHERE [cr884_priority] = 'High' AND [cr884_ticketstatus] = 'Open' GROUP BY [cr884_category]
